text:
Jiayun Zheng: Hi all! I'm Jiayun (she/her) — excited to join the Serving Runtime team today. Quick list of first-day asks: MDM laptop enrollment, building access/badge, who my onboarding buddy is, and whether there's anything I should run locally to verify my dev environment. Fun fact: I make boba and collect vintage mechanical keyboards. :bubble_tea: :keyboard:
Karen M.: welcome Jiayun!!! :wave: buddy is @Ana R. — she'll ping you for a quick intro call. For badge/access DM facilities and cc me if you hit delays.
Ana R.: hey Jiayun — sending calendar invite for a 15m sync in 30m. I can take you through Slack channels, swag, and the 1p onboarding checklist.
Jiayun Zheng: thanks Ana! also where do I request a standing desk if I need one?
Evan L.: FYI you can request equipment here: https://redwood/internal/equipment-requests — choose "Ergonomics" for standing desk. It takes ~3–5 biz days.
Tess P.: re: MDM, watch for the email from Jamf. If you don't see it, ping @IT Bot or run this after you connect to corp VPN:
```
sudo jamf enroll
/join-device
```
IT Bot: Automated message: Welcome Jiayun! Your account provisioning is in progress. Expected completion: 2 hours. If provisioning fails, contact it-support@redwood.com with your employee ID.
Jiayun Zheng: got it — I see the Jamf email, I'm running enroll now. Also trying to add my SSH key for GitHub — any tips?
Evan L.: add your pub key to https://github.com/orgs/redwood/settings/keys or run `ssh -T git@github.com` to test. If you need a new key, we prefer ed25519.
Jiayun Zheng: `ssh -T` works, yay. One more: is there a canonical prompt template or eval harness I should look at for runtime tests?
Karen M.: yes — check the onboarding repo: https://gitlab.redwood/onboarding/runtime-quickstart. There's a small script `run_smoke.sh` that spins up local docker instance and runs a sample prompt set.
Ana R.: also, we have a short "first-week goals" doc in the new-hires channel — it'll show you quick wins for week 1.
HR Bot: Heads up: benefits enrollment form is due within 30 days. Link: https://redwood/hr/benefits.
Jiayun Zheng: thanks everyone! last quick thing — lunch preferences: I'm allergic to shellfish but will bring boba to share if anyone wants. Also happy to join keyboard-club later :)
Tess P.: omg boba yes. Welcome again! :confetti_ball:
Evan L.: major +1 to keyboard-club. If you want to test latency numbers later, ping me — I have a small suite of perf tests you can run on dev boxes.
Jiayun Zheng: awesome, will do. Thanks all — feel free to DM for any follow-ups.
(Reaction summary: Karen M. :thumbsup: on first message, Ana R. :wave:, Evan L. :party_parrot:)
